definition: In this historical source, expansiveness means an exalted, grandiose state of delusion in which a person feels unusually elevated and powerful and elaborates sweeping claims about their abilities, possessions, or importance. It refers to the tendency for these self-exalting ideas to grow and spread beyond the person’s actual circumstances.
